bible_quanes.question: How should we count it when we fall into various trials?
bible_quanes.answer: All joy

bible_quanes.question: What should we do if we lack wisdom?
bible_quanes.answer: Ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally

bible_quanes.question: What should we be, not hearers only?
bible_quanes.answer: Doers of the word

bible_quanes.question: From where does every good and perfect gift come?
bible_quanes.answer: From above, from the Father of lights
bible_quanes.explanation: With whom there is no variation.

bible_quanes.question: To whom is James written?
bible_quanes.answer: The twelve tribes scattered abroad

bible_quanes.question: To what is the one who doubts compared?
bible_quanes.answer: A wave of the sea driven and tossed by the wind

bible_quanes.question: What does James say about God and temptation?
bible_quanes.answer: God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man
bible_quanes.explanation: Each is drawn by his own desires.

bible_quanes.question: How should everyone be?
bible_quanes.answer: Swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath

bible_quanes.question: What is pure and undefiled religion?
bible_quanes.answer: To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world

bible_quanes.question: To what is a hearer and not a doer compared?
bible_quanes.answer: A man beholding his natural face in a glass

bible_quanes.question: What is faith without works?
bible_quanes.answer: Dead

bible_quanes.question: What should we not hold the faith with?
bible_quanes.answer: Respect of persons

bible_quanes.question: What do the demons believe?
bible_quanes.answer: That there is one God, and tremble

bible_quanes.question: What was Abraham called?
bible_quanes.answer: The friend of God

bible_quanes.question: What illustration of partiality does James give?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye say unto him in goodly apparel, Sit thou here in a good place; and to the poor, Stand thou there

bible_quanes.question: Whom has God chosen?
bible_quanes.answer: The poor of this world to be rich in faith

bible_quanes.question: What is the royal law?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself

bible_quanes.question: What happens if one stumbles in one point of the law?
bible_quanes.answer: He is guilty of all

bible_quanes.question: Which woman was justified by works when she received the messengers?
bible_quanes.answer: Rahab the harlot

bible_quanes.question: By what was Abraham justified when he offered Isaac?
bible_quanes.answer: Works

bible_quanes.question: What can no man tame?
bible_quanes.answer: The tongue

bible_quanes.question: What does James warn about becoming teachers?
bible_quanes.answer: They shall receive the greater condemnation

bible_quanes.question: How is the wisdom from above described?
bible_quanes.answer: Pure, peaceable, gentle, easy to be intreated, full of mercy

bible_quanes.question: What comes out of the same mouth?
bible_quanes.answer: Blessing and cursing

bible_quanes.question: What do we put in horses' mouths?
bible_quanes.answer: Bits

bible_quanes.question: What turns large ships?
bible_quanes.answer: A very small helm

bible_quanes.question: What is the tongue called in James 3:6?
bible_quanes.answer: A fire, a world of iniquity

bible_quanes.question: What can a fig tree not bear?
bible_quanes.answer: Olive berries

bible_quanes.question: What is present where envy and self-seeking exist?
bible_quanes.answer: Confusion and every evil work

bible_quanes.question: How is the fruit of righteousness sown?
bible_quanes.answer: In peace of them that make peace

bible_quanes.question: What will the devil do if we resist him?
bible_quanes.answer: Flee from us

bible_quanes.question: What will God do if we draw near to Him?
bible_quanes.answer: Draw nigh to us

bible_quanes.question: What is our life, according to James 4:14?
bible_quanes.answer: A vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away

bible_quanes.question: What will happen if we humble ourselves before the Lord?
bible_quanes.answer: He will lift us up

bible_quanes.question: Where do wars and fights come from?
bible_quanes.answer: Your lusts that war in your members

bible_quanes.question: Why do some ask and not receive?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts

bible_quanes.question: What is friendship with the world?
bible_quanes.answer: Enmity with God

bible_quanes.question: Whom does God resist?
bible_quanes.answer: The proud
bible_quanes.explanation: But gives grace to the humble.

bible_quanes.question: What should we say about our plans?
bible_quanes.answer: "If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that"

bible_quanes.question: What is sin to the one who knows to do good and does not?
bible_quanes.answer: Sin

bible_quanes.question: What does the effective, fervent prayer of a righteous man do?
bible_quanes.answer: Availeth much

bible_quanes.question: Who prayed that it would not rain?
bible_quanes.answer: Elias
bible_quanes.explanation: For three years and six months.

bible_quanes.question: How should our yea and nay be?
bible_quanes.answer: Let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay

bible_quanes.question: What should anyone who is suffering do?
bible_quanes.answer: Pray

bible_quanes.question: What does James tell the rich to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Weep and howl for your miseries

bible_quanes.question: For what does the farmer wait patiently?
bible_quanes.answer: The precious fruit of the earth

bible_quanes.question: Whose perseverance have we heard of?
bible_quanes.answer: Job

bible_quanes.question: What should the sick do?
bible_quanes.answer: Call for the elders of the church to pray and anoint him with oil

bible_quanes.question: What does turning a sinner from his error do?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins

bible_quanes.question: What cries out against the rich?
bible_quanes.answer: The hire of the labourers kept back by fraud
